ai_summary: This document discloses an inter-se transfer of 7.19% of Aakash Exploration Services Limited's shares between two existing promoters, Mr. Krunal Pravin Haria (seller) and Mr. Pravin Vershibhai Haria (acquirer), without monetary consideration (as a gift). This transaction is classified as an internal restructuring within the promoter group, complying with SEBI Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii) and thus exempt from an open offer. The material impact is a redistribution of shares within the promoter group, with no change to the overall promoter shareholding or control over the company, and no apparent red flags.
